messages:
Marco Diaz: big personal news!! Elise and I are expecting twins in September and also she just got promoted to Director of Product this week 389 :tada: :baby_bottle:
Elise Park: ahhhh thanks everyone. trying to process both things at once 64f what a month!
Tom Y.: TWO CONGRATS!! need a party. churros or cake? quick poll because priorities. :churros: churros, :cake: cake, :coffee: coffee & donuts
Sana R.: churros pls. also can we do a tiny card for Elise?
Remy: card yes. i'm on card duty.
Elise Park: please no long speeches, tiny toasts only. also heads-up: will be on partial remote for last two weeks of Sept for appointments.
Marco Diaz: logistics note  well take paternity leave timing from HR in a bit.
Tom Y.: FacilitiesBot, can we reserve the kitchenette Friday 12:30 for a 25-min celebration? GF options needed.
FacilitiesBot: reservation attempt: Kitchenette Fri 12:30-12:55. Please confirm dietary flags: gluten-free and nut-free requested. Link: https://calendar.company/evt/2155554321
Sana R.: confirmed - i'll bring GF churros (recipe from my abuela) and sparkling water.
Remy: i'll bring a small cake (GF) and the card.
Elise Park: youre all too kind. thank you. if anyone wants to drop a quick congrats note in this thread, we'll read them at lunch.
Tom Y.: congrats Elise!!! youve earned this. so thrilled for both of you :heart:
Sana R.: congrats congrats!! twins!! :star_struck:
Marco Diaz: cannot wait to meet them. thank you all for the love.
FacilitiesBot: calendar event created and invites sent. Reminder set 24h before.
